what: What did each Lunenburg town employee earn in 1986?
why: `report-gross-wages` holds per-employee earnings from the 1995-2010 reports (calendar or as printed) and FY2011-FY2025 (fiscal). The 1986 annual town report prints no wage list: the whole text (122 pages) was searched for wage, gross, salary and payroll and found only the Treasurer's payroll DEDUCTION totals (p36, p39), the Auditor's note that he reviewed payroll time sheets (p10), and the line `Special Detail Wages` (p38) (sources/data/report-tables/1986/). — closes: the Town's calendar-1986 payroll register (W-2 totals by employee) from the Treasurer's office.

what: What were the town's non-union salary grades and step rates in fiscal 1987?
why: `salary-schedule` and `report-classification-plan` read Schedule A from the 2010 report and FY2011 onward. The 1986 annual town report records only the article (p70: an article `by deleting the Classification and Salary Schedule voted on May 11, 1985 and substituting` another) and not the schedule; searched for classification, salary schedule, step and grade (sources/data/report-tables/1986/). — closes: the Finance Committee's report to the April 12, 1986 Annual Town Meeting, which printed the Classification & Salary Schedule.

what: What did each special revenue fund take in, spend and carry forward in fiscal 1986, town-wide?
why: `special-revenue-funds` holds forward, receipts, disbursements and balance by fund from the 1995-2010 reports. The 1986 report prints the revolving funds' YEAR-END balances only, as lines of the general fund balance sheet (p40 `Other Revolving Funds`: School Lunch, School Athletic, Park Department-User Fees ...), and the School Department's own special accounts with balance on hand, expenditures and July 1 balance (p113-115); no town-wide receipts-and-disbursements schedule by fund. Searched revolving and special revenue (sources/data/report-tables/1986/). — closes: the Town Accountant's fiscal 1986 special revenue fund ledger.

what: What was appropriated, spent and carried forward on each capital project fund in fiscal 1986?
why: `report-capital-projects` holds a separate capital project fund schedule from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1986 report prints no such schedule: its balance sheet carries `Appropriation for Capital Improvements` as reserve lines (p41) and the accountant's schedule lists each article (p54-59), so whether any project sat in a separate fund is not shown. Searched capital project and capital fund (sources/data/report-tables/1986/). — closes: the Town Accountant's fiscal 1986 capital projects fund ledger.

what: What did each item of Lunenburg's FY1987 capital plan cost?
why: `capital-plans` holds item-by-item costs. The 1986 report prints no capital plan: the only mention is the town's selection for a Capital Needs Prioritization process with a consultant (p6). Searched for capital (sources/data/report-tables/1986/). — closes: the capital needs prioritization report that process produced, or the Finance Committee's FY1987 report listing capital articles.

what: What was Lunenburg's assessed valuation by property class, its levy, overlay and new growth for fiscal 1987?
why: `report-valuation` holds the Assessors' tables (assessments by class, valuation and tax history, abstract by class code, overlay, new growth) from the 1995-2010 reports and FY2011 onward. The 1986 report prints the total valuation and tax rate in prose (p3, p10: the FY '87 rate and total valuation) and one reserve line (`Reserve Fund Overlay Surplus`, p42) but no table by class, no levy figure and no new-growth figure. Searched for valuation, overlay, tax rate, new growth, levy and assessment (sources/data/report-tables/1986/). — closes: the Assessors' FY1987 tax rate recapitulation (Form LA-4/recap) filed with the Department of Revenue.

what: How many weighing and measuring devices did the Sealer test in 1986, and what did sealing bring in by device?
why: `report-weights-measures` holds the Sealer's device counts and fees from the 2010 report. The 1986 report prints only the receipts line `Sealing Fees` in the statement of receipts (p37) and the appointment of an Inspector of Weights & Measures (p5); no device counts and no fee schedule. Searched for weights, sealer and sealing (sources/data/report-tables/1986/). — closes: the Sealer of Weights and Measures' 1986 annual report to the Division of Standards.
